verdict.rationale: The evidence pack details llamafile's chat/completion, multimodal image, and speech-to-text (whisperfile) capabilities, and lists supported GGUF model families (Llama, Mistral, Gemma, Phi), but nowhere mentions embedding model support, an embeddings API endpoint, or retrieval/search use cases. Missing for 10: any documentation or community evidence of an --embedding server mode, embedding-specific GGUF model support, or vector/retrieval workflow examples.
